006package gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.datatype.adapter;
007
008import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.MetapathConstants;
009import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic.IYearMonthDurationItem;
010import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.qname.EQNameFactory;
011import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.qname.IEnhancedQName;
012import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.util.ObjectUtils;
013
014import java.time.Period;
015import java.util.List;
016import java.util.regex.Matcher;
017import java.util.regex.Pattern;
018
019import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
020
021/**
022 * Support for the Metaschema <a href=
023 * "https://pages.nist.gov/metaschema/specification/datatypes/#year-month-duration">year-month-duration</a>
024 * data type.
025 */
026public class YearMonthAdapter
027    extends AbstractDurationAdapter<Period, IYearMonthDurationItem> {
028  @NonNull
029  private static final List<IEnhancedQName> NAMES = ObjectUtils.notNull(
030      List.of(
031          EQNameFactory.instance().newQName(MetapathConstants.NS_METAPATH, "year-month-duration")));
032
033  private static final Pattern YEAR_MONTH_DURATION_PATTERN = Pattern.compile(
034      "^(?<sign>-)?"
035          + "P"
036          + "(?:(?<year>[0-9]+)Y)?"
037          + "(?:(?<month>[0-9]+)M)?"
038          + "$");
039
040  YearMonthAdapter() {
041    super(Period.class, IYearMonthDurationItem.class, IYearMonthDurationItem::cast);
042  }
043
044  @Override
045  public List<IEnhancedQName> getNames() {
046    return NAMES;
047  }
048
049  @Override
050  public Period copy(Object obj) {
051    // value in immutable
052    return (Period) obj;
053  }
054
055  @Override
056  public Period parse(String value) {
057    Matcher matcher = YEAR_MONTH_DURATION_PATTERN.matcher(value);
058
059    if (!matcher.matches()) {
060      throw new IllegalArgumentException(
061          String.format("String duration '%s' is not a year/month duration.", value));
062    }
063
064    String year = matcher.group(2);
065    String month = matcher.group(3);
066    return parsePeriod(matcher.group(1) != null, year, month);
067  }
068
069  @Override
070  public IYearMonthDurationItem newItem(Object value) {
071    Period item = toValue(value);
072    return IYearMonthDurationItem.valueOf(item);
073  }
074}
